slug: 2025-12-18 Seamfix revealed as developer of Benin's biometric passport renewal app

BEN.note: Passport renewal app; says nothing of civil register links.
No count or share of people holding a national ID.
Says nothing of an ID number at birth.
The supplier contract is for a passport app, not the national ID system.
Says nothing of public registers keyed on the ID number.
The national ID system is named only as something the passport app integrates with; its status is not stated.
